input: Choose a charity to volunteer with quarterly

gold.taskTitle: Choose a Charity to Volunteer With Quarterly
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to select a charitable organization to volunteer with on a quarterly basis.

questions.title: What cause area matters most to you personally?
questions.description: Identify the user's core area of interest, such as hunger relief, animal welfare, education, environment, or homelessness.

questions.title: How many hours per quarter can you commit?
questions.description: Understand the time budget available per volunteering session or across the full quarter.

questions.title: Do you prefer hands-on work or remote tasks?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants in-person, physical volunteering or remote and administrative support roles.

questions.title: What city or region should the charity be based in?
questions.description: Establish the geographic scope so only locally accessible or relevant organizations are considered.

questions.title: Do you want to volunteer alone or with a group?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a solo commitment or intended for a team, family, or corporate group.

questions.title: Are there any skills you specifically want to contribute?
questions.description: Find out if the user has professional or personal skills, such as medical, legal, cooking, or teaching, they want to apply.

questions.title: Have you volunteered before and what did not work?
questions.description: Uncover past experiences and pain points to avoid repeating unsuitable charity types or volunteer structures.
